meta.measures: Who still carries traffic for tracked hosting providers, and when they stopped.
meta.why_this_can_mislead: A network going dark is disconnection, not proof of enforcement: providers renumber and abandon AS numbers commercially. The monthly history counts all observed neighbours, mixing transit with peering; only the current upstream figure is a transit count. Never read the two as the same number.
